en.headline: Anderson's first mall opens in stages before 13 October
en.dek: Link says Link Square in the Anderson Road Quarry development is in soft opening, with a formal launch set for 13 October.
body: The first shopping centre in the Anderson Road Quarry development in Kwun Tong is trading in stages, ahead of a formal opening next week.

Link Asset Management said Link Square would officially open on 13 October. A soft-opening period began on 6 October, with some tenants already serving residents of the new Home Ownership Scheme courts that have been taking in households since 2025.

The operator said the mall would bring together close to 30 brands, covering food, retail and daily services, and that a rooftop children's play area called Paw Paw Playland would sit on the top floor. A fresh market is also part of the scheme.

Residents told local reporters this week that a supermarket and shops in the district cut trips down to On Tat and Sau Mau Ping, while some still described the bus links as a remaining inconvenience. Link has also run a shuttle giving out opening souvenirs around Anderson, Kwun Tong and Sau Mau Ping until 12 October.

zh.headline: 安達臣首個商場領達廣場分階段啟用 13日正式開幕
zh.dek: 領展表示，觀塘安達臣道石礦場發展區的領達廣場已於10月6日起試業，正式開幕訂於10月13日。
body: 觀塘安達臣道石礦場發展區的首個商場領達廣場，正分階段投入服務，正式開幕訂於下周二。
領展資產管理表示，廣場於10月6日展開試業，部分商戶已率先營業，正式開幕日期為10月13日。區內居屋項目自2025年起陸續入伙，包括安楹苑、安樺苑、安麗苑及安柏苑。
領展指，廣場匯聚近30個品牌，涵蓋食肆、零售及生活服務，天台設兒童遊樂場「爪爪童樂園」，並設鮮活街市。10月6日至12日期間，領展亦安排專車穿梭安達臣、觀塘及秀茂坪派發開幕小禮。
有居民向本地傳媒表示，區內多了超市和商舖後，買餺不必每次落到安達或秀茂坪；亦有人指巴士路線仍然不便。領展未有在公告中列出全部商戶的營業時間。
